blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Photorealistic volume rendering of computed tomography (CT) may convey anatomy intuitively, but it needs the CT data, dedicated software and a powerful graphics processor. Three-dimensional Gaussian splatting (3DGS) displays photorealistic scenes in real time on less powerful devices, but existing medical approaches train each scene for minutes to hours. We aimed to convert a CT volume rendering directly into a 3DGS model without training. Splats were placed on an adaptive octree of millimetre-sized cells. Their colour and opacity were computed on the graphics processor with the renderer's lighting, cell opacity was converted analytically into splat opacity, and faint splats were retained stochastically above the 1/255 opacity floor of standard 3DGS rasterisers. Six public CT scans (1.5-mm voxels) were converted with three transfer functions and compared with converged references by peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity and a learned perceptual metric. Two-million-splat models reached a PSNR of 32.6 +/- 0.9 dB for bone, 30.1 +/- 1.0 dB for contrast-enhanced vessels and 32.3 +/- 1.5 dB for skin and bone. A conversion pass (usually two or three per model) took 4-30 s on a current laptop and 9-60 s on a desktop with a 4-GB graphics card. On the laptop, the models rendered at 68 frames per second at 800 x 800 pixels. Training-free conversion produced real-time 3DGS models of photorealistic CT renderings in about a minute or less per conversion pass on ordinary computers, with fidelity that we consider sufficient for interactive viewing.
blocks.zh: 计算成像法(CT)的光现实化量渲染可以直观地传达解剖学,但它需要CT数据,专用软件和强大的图形处理器. 三维高斯克平板(3DGS)在不太强大的设备上实时显示光现实主义场景,但现有的医疗方法对每个场景进行数分钟到数小时的训练. 我们的目标是将一个CT卷直接渲染成3DGS模型而不经过训练. 将花板放入一个适应性小于大小的细胞。 在图形处理器上用渲染器的照明计算出它们的颜色和不透明性,从分析上将电池不透明性转换为平板不透明性,将微弱的平板保留在标准3DGS光栅的1/255不透明地上方。 6个公用CT扫描(1.5-mm voxels)被转换出有3个传输功能,并与以峰值信号-噪声比(PSNR),结构相近和一个有学识的知觉度量度来对比的引用. 200万平板模型的PSNR为:骨干32.6+/-0.9分贝,30.1分贝+/- 对比增强的器皿为1.0分贝,皮肤和骨骼为32.3分贝+/-1.5分贝. 转会通行证(通常每个型号为2到3个)用4-30 s来换取当前笔记本电脑,9-60 s来换取4-GB图形卡. 在笔记本电脑上,模型以每秒68帧,800x800像素提供. 无训练转换在每一次转换中大约一分钟或更短的时间内就产生了相片现实化CT渲染的实时3DGS模型被普通计算机传出,其忠诚性被我们认为足以进行互动取景.

blocks.en: 1 Background
blocks.zh: 1 背景情况

blocks.en: Photorealistic volume rendering of computed tomography (CT) simulates light scattering in tissue and has the capacity to depict anatomy with apparent lifelike depth and shading [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . It speeds anatomical understanding compared with conventional CT images and serves surgical planning, teaching, patient communication and documentation [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] . However, it needs the CT data, dedicated software and a powerful graphics processing unit (GPU), so results are usually shared as still images or videos.
blocks.zh: 计算成形图(CT)的光现实化量渲染模拟了光在组织中的散射,并能够以明显的生物深度和阴影描绘解剖[1、2、3、4]。 与传统的CT图像相比,它加快了解剖理解,并为外科规划、教学、病人沟通和文件服务[5、6、7、8]。 然而,它需要CT数据,专用软件和强大的图形处理单元(GPU),因此结果通常作为静态图像或视频共享.

blocks.en: Three-dimensional Gaussian splatting (3DGS) represents a scene as millions of semi-transparent Gaussians rasterised in real time [ 9 ] . Standard 3DGS viewers display such models directly, so a 3DGS model of a CT rendering could be viewed, also in head-mounted displays, without the CT data or renderer. For medical and scientific volumes, most methods optimise Gaussians iteratively against tens to over a thousand rendered views per scene, for minutes to over an hour on a dedicated GPU [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] ; one refines an analytic initialisation [ 17 ] . Feed-forward networks predict Gaussians within seconds but must first be trained on about 100–1,000 volumes with rendered views [ 18 , 19 ] . Most optimised models must be rebuilt, or extended [ 15 , 16 ] , when the transfer function changes.
blocks.zh: 三维高斯电镀(3DGS)代表了百万半透明的高斯电镀实时[9]的场景. 标准3DGS的查看器直接显示这种模型,因此可以查看一个CT渲染的3DGS模型,也可以在头架显示器中查看,没有CT数据或渲染器. 就医学和科学卷而言,大多数方法迭代地优化高斯人对数万至千余个场景的观察,在专门的GPU上持续几分钟至一小时以上[10、11、12、13、14、15、16];一种方法改进了分析初始化[17]。 Feed-forward网络在数秒内预测高斯人, 当传输函数发生变化时,大多数优化模型必须重建,或延长[15,16].

blocks.en: A volume, however, already defines what a Gaussian representation needs: where the material is, how opaque it is and, once lit, its colour. Gaussian kernels have long served direct volume rendering, notably in elliptical weighted average (EWA) splatting [ 20 ] . Instead of optimising or learning Gaussians from rendered images, we aimed to bake the appearance of a lit CT rendering directly into Gaussians, so that conversion is immediate on ordinary hardware. The contribution is not a new rendering model but the removal of the prerequisites of existing 3DGS pipelines: rendered training views, a dedicated GPU and per-scene training time. We describe CTBakeGS and measure how faithfully it reproduces the original rendering.
blocks.zh: 然而,一卷已经定义了高斯人代表需要什么:材料在哪里,多么不透明,一旦点亮,其颜色如何. 高斯内核长期服务于直接的体积渲染,尤其是在椭圆加权平均值(EWA)电镀[20]. 我们不是从渲染的图像中优化或学习高斯人,而是着眼于烤制一个点亮的CT直接渲染到高斯人身上的外表,这样转换就直接出现在普通硬件上. 这一贡献不是一种新的渲染模式,而是取消了现有的3DGS管道的先决条件:提供培训观点、专用GPU和每场培训时间。 我们描述CTBakeGS,并衡量它如何忠实地复制原始渲染.

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Conversion
blocks.zh: 2.1 改划

blocks.en: A CT volume stores voxel-wise radiodensity values in Hounsfield units. A direct volume rendering is fully defined by three inputs: the CT data, a transfer function that maps Hounsfield units to colour and opacity [ 21 ] , and the virtual lighting. A 3DGS model, in turn, is a set of Gaussian splats. Each splat is a small, “soft”, semi-transparent blob in space, described by a position, a size and orientation (scale and rotation; a sphere or a stretched ellipsoid), an opacity and a colour; its opacity is highest at the centre and fades smoothly with distance from it [ 9 ] . A splat differs from a voxel in three respects. First, a voxel is one sample of a regular grid, so its position and size are fixed by the grid, whereas a splat can be placed anywhere and have any size. Second, a voxel stores a measured quantity, in CT the X-ray attenuation in Hounsfield units, and says nothing about appearance; a splat stores the appearance itself, that is, how that piece of the scene looks. Third, a voxel volume becomes an image only through volume rendering (transfer function, lighting and ray casting) [ 21 ] , whereas splats are simply projected onto the screen and blended in depth order [ 9 , 20 ] , which graphics processors do very quickly.
blocks.zh: 在Hounsfield单元中,一个CT体积存储了具有 voxel 特性的放射性密度值。 直接的卷渲染由三个输入完全定义: CT 数据,一个将Hounsfield单位映射到色彩和不透明度[21]的传输函数,以及虚拟照明. 3DGS模型,依次为一套高斯板. 每个板块是空间中一个小的,“软的”,半透明的块块,用一个位置,大小和方向(尺度和旋转;球体或伸展椭圆形),不透明性和颜色来描述;它的不透明度在中央最高,随它的距离而平稳淡去[9]. 一块板子在三个方面与瓶子不同. 首先,一个voxel是常规网格的一个样本,因此其位置和大小由网格固定,而一个板块可以放置在任何地方,并具有任何大小. 第二,一个阴道储存了一定的数量,在CT中,Hounsfield单位的X射线衰减,并且不说外观;一个浮标储存外观本身,也就是现场的碎片的外观。 第三,一个 voxel 音量只能通过音量渲染(传输功能,照明和射线铸造)[21]成为图像,而片板则只是被投射到屏幕上,并按深度顺序混合[9,20],而图形处理器做的非常快.

blocks.en: CTBakeGS derives splats directly from the volume: the volume is divided into small cells, each cell becomes one splat, and each splat receives the colour and opacity that the lit volume rendering gives to its cell.
blocks.zh: CTBakeGS直接从体积中产生鳞片:体积分为小细胞,每个细胞变成一个鳞片,每个鳞片得到点燃体积渲染给其细胞的颜色和不透明度.

blocks.en: This takes five steps, described in turn below (Fig. 1 ): (1) virtual lighting is precomputed, so that it can be stored in the splat colours; (2) the volume is divided into cells, which set the positions and sizes of the splats; (3) colour and opacity are sampled within each cell; (4) cell opacity is converted into splat opacity, as neighbouring splats overlap to generate a smooth realistic appearance; and (5) faint splats, which would vanish below the 1/255 opacity floor of standard rasterisers, are retained stochastically with raised opacity. An anti-aliasing compensation is applied when the splats are drawn. The result is written as a standard 3DGS file (.ply or .spz).
blocks.zh: 这需要五个步骤,下面依次描述(图1): (1)虚拟照明被预先计算,从而可以存储在镀层颜色中; (2)体积被分为细胞,从而确定镀层的位置和大小; (3)彩色和不透明在每个细胞内取样; (4)细胞不透明被转换为镀层不透明,因为相邻的镀层重叠,产生平滑的现实外观; (5)微弱的镀层,在标准光栅的1/255不透明底层下消失,与上升的不透明性一起被扭曲地保留. 抽取牌子时适用反变相补偿. 结果被写成标准3DGS文件(.ply或.spz).

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Training-free conversion of a CT volume rendering into 3D Gaussian splats. The CT volume is shown with a chosen transfer function, which maps Hounsfield units to colour and opacity; the boxes marked Step 1–5 correspond to the steps in the text. A light volume, shared with the photorealistic renderer, stores the visibility of a sky dome in 24 directions and the transmittance towards a key light with soft shadows. The volume is divided into an adaptive octree of millimetre-sized cubic cells, split only where opacity changes, down to sub-voxel size; the finest size is adjusted to reach the requested number of splats. Each cell is sampled at 27 stratified points with the colour and lighting of the volume renderer, giving one colour with baked lighting and an opacity. Opacity mapping replaces each cell by a Gaussian with the same total opacity, fainter at the centre and wider than the cell ( s = 0.55 ​ h s=0.55h ; top); in a profile through a row of cells, the overlapping Gaussians add up to the opacity of the cells (bottom). Faint splats, whose opacity would fall below the 1/255 floor of standard rasterisers, are retained stochastically with raised opacity. The output is a standard 3DGS file (.ply or .spz); the example shows case 2 with the contrast-enhanced vessel transfer function. CT, computed tomography; 3DGS, three-dimensional Gaussian splatting
blocks.zh: 费格。 1: CT卷渲染为3D高斯板的无训练转换. CT卷以一个选中的传输函数显示,该函数将Hounsfield单位映射为色彩和不透明;标有步骤1-5的框对应文本中的步骤. 与光现实化渲染器共享的光量将一个天空穹顶的能见度存储在24个方向上,并且向带有柔软阴影的关键光线传递. 体积分为小米大小立方细胞的适应性octree,仅在不透明变化时进行分裂,降为亚伏瑟尔大小;最优化的大小调整以达到要求的片数. 每个电池在27个分层点上取样,标有体积渲染器的颜色和照明,并给出一种带有烤光和不透明的颜色。 不透明映射用一个总不透明度相同的高斯琴来取代每个细胞,中心更昏暗,比细胞更宽(s = 0.55 h s = 0.55h;顶部);在通过一行细胞的剖面图中,重叠的高斯琴加成细胞的不透明度(底部). 花板的不透明程度将低于标准光栅的1/255层,但保留了高不透明度的花板。 输出为标准3DGS文件(.ply或.spz);示例显示案例2带有对比增强的容器传输功能. CT,计算成像;3DGS,三维高斯电镀

blocks.en: In CTBakeGS, each splat has a single view-independent colour that does not change with the viewing direction, whereas 3DGS models trained from images usually store view-dependent colour. Lighting and shadows must therefore be computed before conversion and stored (baked) in that colour. CTBakeGS uses the lighting of its own photorealistic volume renderer, which approximates global illumination with a precomputed light volume of about 112 cells along the longest axis. For each light-volume cell, rays cast through the transfer-function opacity give the visibility of a sky dome in 24 directions and the transmittance towards a key light, which produces soft shadows. A sample’s colour is multiplied by the visibility-weighted sky light plus the transmittance-weighted key light and then tone-mapped. The renderer has a real-time view (one pass per frame), which supplies the colours for conversion, and a progressive view, which averages jittered frames until the image converges.
blocks.zh: 在CTBakeGS中,每个板块有一个单一的视图独立颜色,不随视图方向而改变,而从图像中训练出来的3DGS模型通常存储视图独立颜色. 因此,在转换和储存(烧焦)之前,必须计算照明和阴影。 CTBakeGS使用它自己的光现实化体积渲染器的照明,它与全球照明相近,沿最长轴线的预计算光量约为112个电池. 对于每个轻量电池,通过传动-函数不透明投射的射线可以使一个24个方向的天穹的能见度和向关键光的传递,产生柔软的阴影. 一个样本的颜色乘以能见度加权的天光,加上传动加权的钥匙灯,然后按音调图。 渲染器具有实时视图(每帧一个通过),为转换提供颜色,并具有渐进视图,平均抖动帧直到图像汇合.

blocks.en: The cells determine where splats are placed and how large they are. Cells of one voxel each would spend many splats on homogeneous regions and would tie the splat count to the voxel count. Cells are therefore organised as an adaptive octree that is refined only where opacity changes. Starting from cells four voxels wide, a cell is split into eight when its opacity varies strongly, that is, when the maximum transfer-function opacity over its Hounsfield-unit range, α max \alpha_{\max} , exceeds the smaller of the opacities at the two ends of that range by more than α max \alpha_{\max} /2 (and α max \alpha_{\max} > 0.01). Homogeneous regions thus keep one large splat, whereas boundaries receive small splats, down to sub-voxel size. The split test extends 1.5 cell widths beyond the cell, so that large splats do not protrude through nearby surfaces. Cells are cubes measured in millimetres (unit: the finest voxel spacing), so that thick-slice data do not produce elongated cells.
blocks.zh: 细胞决定板块的位置和大小. 每个瓶子的细胞会花很多花板 在同质区域, 并将花板计数与瓶子计数联系起来。 因此,细胞被组织成适应性的果树,只有在不透明情况发生变化时才能加以精炼。 从4 Voxel宽的单元格开始,当一个单元格的不透明性差异很大时,即当其Hounsfield-unit范围(α max)上的最大转移函数不透明性(α max\ alpha_{\max})超过该范围两端的不透明性小于α max\ alpha_{\max}/2(和α max\ alpha_{\max} > 0.01)时,该单元格被分成8个. 因此,同一区域保留一个大板块,而边界则接收小板块,降为次伏牛座大小。 分化试验将1.5个细胞宽度延伸到细胞外,这样大块的鳞片不会通过附近的表面延伸. 细胞是用毫米(单位:最佳的阴道间距)测量的立方体,这样厚切片数据就不会产生延长的细胞.

blocks.en: The number of splats follows from the finest permitted cell size. To reach a chosen target count, this size is adjusted, assuming a power law between cell size and splat count, and the conversion is repeated until the count is within 8% of the target, usually after two or three conversion passes. If the target falls between two octree levels, as happened once (case 3, bone, one-million target), the count overshoots.
blocks.zh: 板子的数量来自最佳允许的细胞大小。 要达到一个选定的目标计数,这个大小会被调整,假设在单元格大小和平板计数之间有电源定律,转换会重复进行,直到计数在目标的8%以内,通常是经过两三个转换后. 如果目标落在两个奥克特里水平之间,就像曾经发生过的一样(第3例,骨骼,100万目标),计数会过度射击.

blocks.en: Each cell is now reduced to one colour and one opacity. The cell is sampled on the GPU at 27 stratified points ( 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 ). At each point, the transfer function gives the extinction, and the colour is shaded with the lighting model and light volume of the real-time view (Step 1). The point colours are averaged with weights for extinction and for the transmittance towards the most open axis direction, so that points lying deep inside the cell do not darken it. From the mean extinction σ ¯ \bar{\sigma} and the cell size h h , the cell opacity is α cell = 1 − exp ⁡ ( − σ ¯ ​ h ) . \alpha_{\mathrm{cell}}=1-\exp\!\left(-\bar{\sigma}h\right). (1)

blocks.en: Standard 3DGS rasterisers skip splats whose opacity is below 1/255, and compact formats such as .spz store opacity with 8 bits, so a splat with α splat \alpha_{\mathrm{splat}} below this floor vanishes. In a thin translucent layer, every cell is below the floor, although many such cells along an oblique ray add up to a visible veil; discarding them removes the whole layer. CTBakeGS therefore keeps a faint splat ( α splat \alpha_{\mathrm{splat}} < α 0 \alpha_{0} , with α 0 \alpha_{0} = 0.01, about 2.5/255, so that it stays above the floor after the anti-aliasing compensation) with probability τ splat / τ 0 \tau_{\mathrm{splat}}/\tau_{0} , where τ 0 = − ln ⁡ ( 1 − α 0 ) \tau_{0}=-\ln(1-\alpha_{0}) , and assigns it the opacity α 0 \alpha_{0} . The expected optical depth of the lattice is unchanged, and fewer splats are needed. The choice uses a hash of the cell index, so the conversion remains deterministic.

blocks.en: To avoid aliasing, 3DGS rasterisers enlarge each projected Gaussian by a small screen-space filter (variance 0.3 pixel 2 ). This makes small splats appear thicker than intended [ 22 ] . As in Mip-Splatting [ 22 ] , the splat opacity is therefore multiplied at drawing time by w = det ( Σ ) det ( Σ + 0.3 ​ I ) , w=\sqrt{\frac{\det(\Sigma)}{\det(\Sigma+0.3I)}}, (5) where Σ \Sigma is the projected covariance and I the identity matrix.
blocks.zh: 为了避免别名,3DGS光栅放大器通过一个小屏幕-空间滤波器(变形0.3像素2 )将每个投射的高斯星放大. 这使得小板看起来比预期的厚 [22]. 与Mip-Splateting [22]中一样,在绘图时,浮标不透明度乘以w= det( + 0.3 I),w=sqrt=frac=det(\Sigma)\\det(\Sigma+0.3I)=, (5) 其中\\西格玛是预测的共性,而I是身份矩阵.

blocks.en: 2.2 Implementation
blocks.zh: 2.2 执行情况

blocks.en: CTBakeGS is a single HTML file (JavaScript, WebGL 2) that runs locally in a web browser. It is available at https://github.com/BocchiSlice/CTBakeGS ; version 1.0 was used for all measurements.
blocks.zh: CTBakeGS是单一的HTML文件(JavaScript,WebGL 2),在网页浏览器中本地运行. 可在https://github.com/BocchiSlice/CTBakeGS网址查阅;所有测量都使用了1.0版。

blocks.en: 2.3 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.3 评价

blocks.en: We used six CT scans from two scanner vendors in the TotalSegmentator dataset v2 (CC BY 4.0) [ 23 ] : case 1 (s0289), head CT angiography; case 2 (s0138), heart and thoracic aorta; case 3 (s1340), thorax to pelvis; case 4 (s0970), polytrauma; case 5 (s1121), pelvis-to-leg CT angiography; case 6 (s0931), neck-to-leg CT angiography (Supplementary Table S1 ). All have 1.5-mm isotropic voxels (215–519 slices; 4.9–56.7 million voxels). For the thick-slice test, the 1.5-mm slices of case 1 were also averaged along the slice direction in groups spanning 5 mm, giving voxels of 1.5 × 1.5 × 5 1.5\times 1.5\times 5 mm.
blocks.zh: 我们在TotalSegates data set v2(CC BY 4.0)[23]:案例1(s0289),头部CT血管学;案例2(s0138),心脏和胸肌主动脉学;案例3(s1340),胸腔至骨盆学;案例4(s0970),多创伤;案例5(s1121),骨盆至腿部CT血管学;案例6(s0931),颈部CT血管学(补充表S1)。 均具有1.5毫米异辛醇/水分配系数(215-519片;490-567万伏克塞尔)。 在厚切片试验中,例1的1.5毫米切片也平均沿切片方向排列,分为5毫米的组别,给排卵瓶1.5×1.5×5×1.5乘1.5×5毫米。

blocks.en: Each scan was rendered with three preset transfer functions (bone; contrast-enhanced vessels; skin and bone), giving 18 scenes plus three for the 5-mm data. For each scene, 48 wide views (16 azimuths at three elevations) and 16 close-up views were rendered at 800 × 800 800\times 800 pixels on a black background. Close-up views were centred on visible surface points chosen by farthest-point sampling, at 0.3 times the wide distance. The reference image for each view was rendered by the progressive view of the renderer (Step 1), from the same volume, transfer function and lighting, by averaging 128 jittered frames. The same view averaged over 256 frames differed from it by a peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR; see Metrics) of 54.7–58.7 dB, a root-mean-square (RMS) difference below half an 8-bit grey level and far smaller than the differences of the 3DGS models, so the reference was considered converged.
blocks.zh: 每一次扫描都带有三个预设的传动功能(骨;对比增强的器皿;皮肤和骨骼),给出了18幕+3的5毫米数据. 每个场景都有48个宽视距(3个高空16个方位角)和16个特写视距,以800×800800\时速800像素在黑色背景上进行. 近距离观测以最远点取样所选择的可见表面点为中心,为宽度的0.3倍。 每个视图的参考图像都是由渲染器的渐进视图(步骤1)从相同的音量,传动功能和照明,通过平均128个抖动的帧制成的. 平均超过256帧的同样观点不同,最高信号-噪音比(PSNR;见Metrics)为54.7-58.7。 dB,一个根-正方位(RMS)的差值低于半个8位灰度,且远小于3DGS模型的差值,因此该引用被认为是趋同的.

blocks.en: The 3DGS models were rasterised from the same cameras.
blocks.zh: 3DGS型号是从相同的相机中光栅化的.

blocks.en: Each 3DGS model was compared with the reference by PSNR, computed over the whole image and over the foreground (pixels non-black in either image), the structural similarity index (SSIM) [ 24 ] and the learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS, VGG backbone) [ 25 ] . PSNR is 20 log 10 \log_{10} of the full-scale value divided by the RMS pixel difference; 20 dB more means a tenfold smaller RMS difference, and 32 dB corresponds to about 2.5% of full scale, or 6 of 255 grey levels in an 8-bit image. We also recorded splat counts, conversion times and frame rates; frame rates were measured in the built-in WebGL rasteriser of CTBakeGS.
blocks.zh: 每个3DGS模型都与PSNR的参考物进行了比较,该参考物通过整个图像和前景(图像中任何一个图像都不黑像素),结构相似性指数(SSIM)[24]和所学知觉图像补丁相似性(LPIPS,VGG骨干)[25]. PSNR是全尺寸值的20 log 10\log_{10}除以 RMS 像素差; 20 dB 多表示一个十倍小的 RMS 差, 32 dB 对应于全尺度的2.5%左右,即一个8位图像中的255个灰度的6个. 我们还记录了浮标计数、转换时间和帧率;帧率是在CTBakeGS内置的WebGL光栅仪中测量的。

blocks.en: To test how splat count and the individual conversion steps affect fidelity, we evaluated models with about 1, 2 (main setting) and 3 million splats, and five ablations, each of which removes or replaces one step: • no opacity mapping (Step 4; cell opacity used as is); • no anti-aliasing compensation; • without faint splats (Step 5; splats below the 8-bit floor discarded); • a uniform grid with one cell per voxel instead of the adaptive octree (Step 2), compared with the octree at the same number of splats; • voxel-unit instead of millimetre cells (Step 2; 5-mm data only).
blocks.zh: 为了测试浮点数和单个转换步骤如何影响忠诚,我们用大约1,2(主设置)和300万个浮点数以及5个浮点数来评价模型,每个浮点数消除或替换一个浮点数: · 不不透明绘图(步骤4; 使用的细胞不透明); · 不反变形补偿; · 不微弱浮点数(步骤5; 丢弃的8位底板下方的浮点数); · 统一的网格,每浮点数1个细胞,而不是适应性的星格(步骤2), 与同数量的浮点数的星格相比; · voxel-unit, 而不是毫米细胞(步骤2; 5毫米数据)。

blocks.en: no opacity mapping (Step 4; cell opacity used as is);
blocks.zh: 没有不透明映射(步骤4;目前使用的单元格不透明);

blocks.en: no anti-aliasing compensation;
blocks.zh: (a) 没有反变相赔偿;

blocks.en: without faint splats (Step 5; splats below the 8-bit floor discarded);
blocks.zh: 无微弱的板块(第5步;8位地板以下的板块被丢弃);

blocks.en: a uniform grid with one cell per voxel instead of the adaptive octree (Step 2), compared with the octree at the same number of splats;
blocks.zh: 统一网格,每伏牛1个细胞,而不是适应性果树(步骤2),与相同数量的果树相比;

blocks.en: voxel-unit instead of millimetre cells (Step 2; 5-mm data only).
blocks.zh: voxel-unit 代替毫米电池(步骤2;仅5毫米数据).

blocks.en: Measurements used Chrome 155 on a 14-inch Apple MacBook Pro (2024; M4 Max, 14-core CPU, 32-core GPU, 36 GB memory, macOS 26.6). Speed was also measured on a Windows desktop (Chrome 155; 2018; Intel Core i7-8700, 16 GB memory, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti, 4 GB, Windows 11) and conversion time on a 13-inch Apple MacBook Air (Chrome 137; 2017; 1.8-GHz dual-core Intel Core i5, Intel HD Graphics 6000, 8 GB memory, macOS 12.6).
blocks.zh: 测量在14英寸Apple MacBook Pro(2024年;M4 Max,14核心CPU,32核心GPU,36GB内存,macOS 26.6)上使用了Chrome 155. 在Windows桌面上也测得速度(Chrome 155;2018;Intel Core i7-8700,16 GB内存,NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti,4 GB,Windows 11),在13英寸Apple MacBook Air上转换时间(Chrome 137;2017;1.8-GHz双核心Intel Core i5,Intel HD Graphics 6000,8 GB内存,macOS 12.6).

blocks.en: Metrics were averaged over the views of each scene, and the case was the unit of analysis (mean ± \pm standard deviation over six cases). Variants were compared with the main setting by the two-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test; with six cases the smallest attainable p value is 0.031, and p values are exploratory and not adjusted for multiple comparisons. Analyses used Python 3.9 with NumPy 2.0, SciPy 1.13, pandas 2.3 and lpips 0.1.4 (PyTorch 2.8).
blocks.zh: 每个场景的视差平均为量度,案件为分析单位(平均±\\pm标准偏差超过6例). 通过双面精确的Wilcoxon签名排名测试将变体与主设置进行比较;有6个案例可实现的最小p值为0.031,p值为探索性,不为多重比较进行调整. 分析用Python 3.9与NumPy 2.0,SciPy 1.13,熊猫2.3和lpips 01.4(PyTorch 2.8).

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Fidelity
blocks.zh: 3.1 贞操

blocks.en: Splat counts were within 8% of the targets in every scene except one (case 3, bone, 1.37 million for the one-million target). With two million splats, wide-view PSNR was 32.6 ± \pm 0.9 dB for bone, 30.1 ± \pm 1.0 dB for contrast-enhanced vessels and 32.3 ± \pm 1.5 dB for skin and bone, with SSIM of 0.960–0.980 and LPIPS of 0.028–0.091 (Table 1 ; Fig. 2 ). Close-up views were about 3 dB lower; the real-time photorealistic view reached 42–47 dB. Errors lay mainly along the edges of dense structures for bone and vessels and were spread over the translucent layer for skin and bone (Fig. 2 ). Fidelity was lowest in close-up views of case 4, the largest volume, for bone and vessels (27.1 and 24.0 dB), and in wide views of case 2 for skin and bone (29.8 dB; other cases 32.0–34.5 dB; Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 除了一个场景(第3例,骨骼,一百万目标为137万)之外,每个场景的计数都不超过目标的8%. 宽视PSNR拥有200万块板块,骨料为32.6±pm 0.9 dB,对比增强器皿为30.1±pm 1.0 dB,皮肤和骨料为32.3±pm 1.5 dB,SSIM为0.960–0.980,LPIPS为0.028–0.091(表1;图2). 特写视图低约3 dB;实时摄影现实主义视图达到42–47 dB. 误差主要分布在骨骼和血管密集结构的边缘,并且分布在皮肤和骨骼的半透明层(图2)。 在对案例4的特写意见中,骨骼和器皿(27.1和24.0分贝)和对案例2(皮肤和骨骼(29.8分贝;其他案例32.0-34.5分贝;表2)的特写意见中,精度最低。

blocks.zh: 表2:有200万块胶片的个案图像质量,PSNR(dB)/SSIM/LPIPS

blocks.en: 3.2 Splat count and speed
blocks.zh: 3.2 平板计数和速度

blocks.en: Compared with two million splats, one million lowered close-up PSNR in all cases for bone (median − - 1.2 dB), vessels ( − - 1.3 dB) and skin and bone ( − - 0.9 dB), and three million raised it in all cases (+0.6, +0.8 and +0.4 dB); close-up LPIPS followed the same pattern (Supplementary Table S2 ). A two-million-splat pass took 14.3 s on average (4.2–29.5 s), and rendering ran at 68 frames per second ( 800 × 800 800\times 800 pixels; Table 3 ). A desktop with a 4-GB graphics card needed 29.4 s per pass and rendered 28 frames per second. The 2017 laptop needed 106 s (30–216 s) and rendered 7 frames per second.
blocks.zh: 与200万平板相比,100万平板电脑在骨骼(中间−-1.2 dB)、血管(−-1.3 dB)以及皮肤和骨骼(−-0.9 dB)的所有情况下都降低了特写PSNR;特写LPIPS在所有情况下都采用了同样的模式(补充表S2)。 一个200万平板的通过平均需要14.3秒(4.2–29.5秒),渲染以68帧每秒运行(800×800800\时800像素;表3). 带有4GB图形卡的桌面每张通行证需要29.4s,每秒完成28帧. 2017年的笔记本电脑需要106 s(30–216 s),每秒完成7帧.

blocks.en: Table 3: Splat counts, conversion times and frame rates
blocks.zh: 表3:平面计数、转换时间和帧率

blocks.en: 3.3 Ablations
blocks.zh: 3.3 违约

blocks.en: Without opacity mapping, PSNR was lower in all cases for every look (median − - 4.5 and − - 5.1 dB for bone in wide and close-up views, − - 1.3 and − - 1.9 dB for vessels, − - 5.3 and − - 5.9 dB for skin and bone; Supplementary Table S2 ). Without anti-aliasing compensation, wide-view PSNR was lower in all cases for bone ( − - 3.8 dB) and vessels ( − - 0.9 dB), with little change for skin and bone and in close-up views. At equal splat count, a uniform grid with one cell per voxel was as faithful as the octree for vessels and skin and slightly better for bone (+0.4 and +0.6 dB, all cases). The voxel grid, however, fixes the splat count (0.14–2.86 million); in the two smallest volumes, two-million-splat octree models exceeded it by 1.3–2.7 dB for bone and vessels. With 5-mm slices, millimetre cells gave PSNR similar to the 1.5-mm data (bone, wide views: 34.3 vs 33.6 dB), whereas voxel-unit cells gave 22.5 dB (Supplementary Table S3 ; per-case details in Supplementary Table S1 ). Without faint splats, PSNR was lower in all cases in wide views (bone − - 0.3 dB, vessels − - 0.4 dB, skin and bone − - 1.6 dB) and in close-up views of vessels and skin and bone ( − - 0.5 and − - 1.4 dB), with little change in LPIPS; the loss was largest in case 2, where wide-view PSNR for skin and bone fell from 29.8 to 23.8 dB (Table 4 ; Fig. 3 ).
blocks.zh: 不绘制不透明图,在所有情况下,所有外观都低于PSNR(中间值为−4.5和−5.1分贝的骨部宽视和近视,1.3和−1.9分贝的血管,5.3和−5.9分贝的皮肤和骨部;补充表S2)。 在没有反变异补偿的情况下,对骨骼(−-3.8 dB)和器皿(−-0.9 dB)的宽视PSNR在所有情况下都较低,对皮肤和骨骼的改变很少,并且是特写。 在相等的血浆计数时,每瓶血浆中有一个细胞的统一网格与对血管和皮肤的奥克树一样忠实,对骨骼略好(+0.4和+0.6 dB,所有病例). 然而,Voxel网格却固定了浮标计数(0.14–286万);在最小的两卷中,200万平板的奥克特里模型超过它1.3–2.7 dB的骨骼和器皿. 使用5毫米切片,毫米电池给出的PSNR与1.5毫米数据相似(bone,宽视:34.3 vs 33.6 dB),而voxel-unit电池给出的是22.5 dB(补充表S3;补充表S1中的个案详情)。 在没有微弱的板块的情况下,PSNR在所有情况中都较低(骨−-0.3 dB,器皿−0.4 dB,皮肤和骨−1.6 dB),在器皿和皮肤和骨骼的特写视图中(0.5和−1.4 dB),LPIPS变化不大;在2例中损失最大,对皮肤和骨骼的广视PSNR从29.8 dB下降到23.8 dB. (表4;图3)

4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: CTBakeGS converted CT volume renderings into standard 3DGS models in about a minute or less per conversion pass, usually two or three passes per model, on a current laptop and on a 2018 desktop with a 4-GB graphics card, without training or per-scene optimisation. The idea is simple, but three steps made it work: the opacity mapping for overlapping splats, the baked lighting and the retention of faint splats above the 8-bit opacity floor. It is deterministic as every splat derives from its cell’s voxels; a new transfer function needs only another conversion; and, with the virtual lighting baked in, standard viewers show the lit result. Because the viewer runs in a web browser, no software has to be installed, and a converted model could be packaged with the viewer page and sent, for example, to patients as their CT scan in a form that runs on ordinary devices. Because splats are a common format, a volume rendering could also be combined with splat models of other origin, such as reconstructions of a crime scene.
blocks.zh: CTBakeGS将CT音量渲染器转换为标准3DGS型号,每次转换口号约1分钟或更短,通常每个型号有2到3个通行证,在一台现时笔记本电脑上和一台带有4GB图形卡的2018桌面上,不经过训练或人均场景优化. 这个想法很简单,但三个步骤使它奏效:为重叠的板块绘制不透明图,烤制的照明和在8位不透明地板上方保留微弱的板块. 它具有决定性意义,因为每个板块都来自其细胞的阴道;一个新的转录功能只需要另一个转换;随着虚拟照明的烘烤,标准观众显示点亮结果。 因为查看器在网页浏览器中运行,所以不需要安装软件,可以将一个转换过的模型与查看器的页面进行包装,例如以普通设备运行的形式作为CT扫描发送给患者. 由于片板是一种通用格式,卷渲染也可以与其他来源的片板模型结合,如犯罪现场的重建.

blocks.en: The fidelity results may define the scope of use. Bone reached about 33 dB in wide and 30 dB in close-up views, corresponding to an RMS pixel difference of about 2.3% and 3.3% of full scale, or 6 and 8 of 255 grey levels, and skin and bone about 29 dB in close-up views (3.5%; 9 of 255), whereas the real-time volume renderer reached 42–47 dB (0.45–0.8%; 1–2 of 255). Contrast-enhanced vessels were weakest in close-up views (27 dB; 4.7%; 12 of 255), where the edges of dense bone and thin vessels were smoothed. In case 4, the largest volume, the same splat budget gave coarser cells, and close-up fidelity rose with more splats (vessels 22.8, 24.0 and 24.8 dB with 1, 2 and 3 million splats), so large volumes may need more splats.
blocks.zh: 忠诚的结果可以确定使用范围。 Bone在宽度上达到约33 dB,在特写视角下达到30 dB,相当于全尺寸的RMS像素差约2.3%和3.3%,即255灰度中的6和8,在特写视角下皮肤和骨骼约29 dB(3.5%;255中的9),而实时体积渲染器则达到42–47 dB(0.45–0.8%;255中的1–2). 相矛盾的增强型舰只在特写视野中最弱(27 dB;4.7%;255艘中的12艘),其中密集的骨骼和薄质舰只的边缘平滑. 例4,最大容量,同一板块预算给予较粗的细胞,特写忠诚度随着更多的板块(vessels 22.8,24.0和24.8 dB加上1,200和300万板块)而上升,因此大容量可能需要更多的板块.

blocks.en: Values reported for trained models (about 21–37 dB [ 10 , 12 , 18 ] ) used different data, resolutions and references and are not directly comparable. Optimisation [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] , feed-forward networks [ 18 , 19 ] and hybrid streaming [ 26 ] remain preferable when the highest fidelity matters and their cost is acceptable. CTBakeGS does not compete with them on fidelity but removes their prerequisites.
blocks.zh: 所报告的训练有素的模型(约21-37 dB[10、12、18])的数值使用了不同的数据、分辨率和参考文献,不具有直接可比性。 优化[10,11,12,13,14,15,16,17],饲料推进网络[18,19]和混合流[26]在最高忠诚度及其成本可以接受时,仍较为可取. CTBakeGS不与她们进行忠诚竞争,而是取消了她们的前提条件。

blocks.en: Faint splats were the main source of error in translucent layers. Standard 3DGS rasterisers discard opacities below 1/255, and the thin outer soft-tissue layer of the skin-and-bone look consists of such faint cells, which are visible in the volume rendering only because many of them add up along oblique rays. Without the retention of Step 5, this layer was largely missing in case 2 and the ribs showed through it (Fig. 3 ); its wide-view PSNR fell from 29.8 to 23.8 dB, and bone and vessels in that case lost 0.5 and 0.7 dB (Table 4 ). In exploratory runs, lowering the discard threshold to 0.001 or not splitting faint cells did not restore the layer (+0.1 and +0.3 dB); retaining faint splats stochastically with raised opacity did. The retained splats are individually denser than the tissue they represent, which gives the layer a fine grain at close range. Isotropic splats may still represent thin translucent sheets poorly, and 3DGS rasterisers sort whole splats rather than samples along each ray [ 27 ] . The translucent skin layer is itself a simplification: real skin has a complex, spectrally varying reflectance with subsurface scattering in its upper layers [ 28 ] , and easy-to-use, realistic skin rendering from CT remains for future research.
blocks.zh: Faint splats是半透明层中错误的主要来源. 标准3DGS光栅喷射器丢弃1/255以下的不透明性,皮肤和骨头外观的薄的外侧软质组织层由这种微弱的细胞组成,这些细胞在体积渲染中可见,只是因为其中许多细胞会沿着斜射线相加. 如果没有第5步保留,这一层基本上在2号事故中缺失(图3);其宽视PSNR从29.8分贝降至23.8分贝,其中骨骼和船只损失0.5分贝和0.7分贝(表4)。 在探索性运行中,将丢弃阈值降低到0.001或不分裂微弱细胞并不能使层恢复(+0.1和+0.3 dB);用增加的不透明度来保留微弱的板块。 留存的鳞片个体密度比它们所代表的组织要高,这让层层在近距离上得到精细的谷物. Isotropic splates 可能仍然代表着薄的半透明板,3DGS光栅将整片的板块进行排序,而不是沿着每条射线的样本[27]. 半透明皮肤层本身就是一种简化:真皮肤具有复杂、光谱变化的反射,其上层的地下散射[28],以及CT残留的易于使用、现实的皮肤渲染。

blocks.en: At equal splat count, the octree was not more faithful than a uniform grid. Its benefit is that the splat count can be chosen, for example two million for every volume, instead of being dictated by the number of voxels, which ranged from 0.14 to 2.86 million here.
blocks.zh: 在相等的浮标计时,奥克特里并不比统一的网格更忠实. 其好处是可以选择浮标计数,例如每个体积200万,而不是由排水量决定,这里排水量从0.14万到286万不等.

blocks.en: This study has limitations. Six cases from one public dataset were used, with 1.5-mm voxels, which are slightly coarser than the maximum slice thickness of 1.25 mm proposed for three-dimensional reconstruction in forensic casework [ 29 ] ; clinical thin-slice scans have up to ten times more voxels and convert more slowly. We also stopped at three million splats; close-up fidelity was still rising at that count, so more splats may improve it further at the cost of file size and frame rate, whereas wide-view fidelity had levelled off. The evaluation has two boundaries of its own. Fidelity was measured against the converged view of the same renderer, whose lighting only approximates global illumination, so agreement with other photorealistic renderers is unknown, and PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS do not establish anatomical accuracy. Nor did we test the use of the models: whether they aid teaching or communication, or are suitable for diagnostic reading, requires reader studies. Finally, two choices in the method were made rather than optimised. The opacity floor of the retained faint splats ( α 0 \alpha_{0} = 0.01) is roughly the smallest value that stays above the 1/255 cut-off after the anti-aliasing compensation, which reduces the drawn opacity of small splats, and the two interact; and lighting, transfer function and clipping are fixed at conversion, so that view-independent colours lose specular highlights.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有局限性。 使用了一个公共数据集的6个病例,有1.5毫米阴道,略微比法医病例中为三维重建提出的最大切片厚度1.25毫米厚度[29];临床的薄切片扫描最多可增加10倍阴道,转换速度更慢. 我们还停留在300万个板块上;特写忠诚度仍在上升,因此,更多的板块可能会以文件大小和帧率为代价进一步改进它,而宽视忠诚度已经平息下来。 评估本身有两个界限。 Fidelity是用同一个渲染器的趋同视图来测量的,其光线光线只接近全球光线,因此与其他光现实化渲染器的一致还不得而知,而PSNR,SSIM和LPIPS并没有建立解剖精度. 我们也没有测试这些模型的使用:无论是有助于教学还是交流,还是适合诊断阅读,都需要读者研究。 最后,在方法方面作出了两个选择,而不是优化。 留存的微弱板块的不透明地板(α 0\alpha_{0}=0.01)大约是抗变异性补偿后停留在1/255断层之上的最小值,这降低了小板块的抽取不透明性,两者相互作用;照明,传动功能和剪切固定在转换时,这样视图独立的颜色就会失去光谱亮度.

blocks.en: Several of these limitations point to the next steps. A larger series, including clinical thin-slice scans, should be tested, and conversion of thin-slice and very large volumes should become faster, for example by caching the Hounsfield-unit ranges of the volume for the octree. It also remains to be determined which computer is the minimum for displaying (rather than converting) the models, how they compare with volume rendering and path tracing in this respect and in compressibility. Whether fine structures such as hairline fractures are preserved also needs to be tested, and the error between the model and the rendering could be used to place more splats where details are lost. Fidelity could rise further with view-dependent colours (spherical harmonics), which would restore highlights, and with flat or anisotropic splats for thin translucent layers [ 30 ] . The converted model could also be edited directly, cut with a clip plane or recoloured by segmented organ, without reconverting. Above all, reader studies are needed to show whether the models aid teaching and communication.
blocks.zh: 其中一些限制指向下一步。 包括临床薄片扫描在内的更大系列应进行测试,薄片和非常大体积的转换速度应加快,例如,为果树切除体积的Hounsfield-unit范围。 还需要确定哪些计算机是显示(而不是转换)这些模型的最低限度,它们如何与容积渲染和路径跟踪进行这方面的比较以及压缩。 是否保留了发线断裂等细小结构也需要测试,模型与渲染之间的错误可以被用来将更多的板块放置在细节丢失的地方. Fidelity可能随着视线依赖的颜色(球形口琴)而进一步上升,这种颜色会恢复亮点,并且为薄半透明层配有扁平或异位板[30]. 转换后的型号也可以直接编辑,用剪辑平面剪切或由片段器官重排,而不进行重排. 最重要的是,需要进行读者研究,以表明这些模式是否有助于教学和交流。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We could demonstrate that photorealistic CT volume renderings can be converted directly into standard 3D Gaussian splats, without training, and displayed in a web browser. Conversion took about a minute or less per pass on a current laptop and on a 2018 desktop with a 4-GB graphics card, and under 4 minutes per pass on a 2017 laptop with integrated graphics. The models reproduce the rendering with root-mean-square errors of about 2.3–3.1% of full scale in wide views. This approach could make complex CT data easier to share and view interactively without the CT data or a volume renderer, with potential value for communication and teaching.
blocks.zh: 我们可以证明,光现实化的CT卷渲染可以直接转换成标准的3D高斯板,不经过训练,在网页浏览器中显示. 转换时每通过1分钟左右使用一台现时笔记本电脑,2018年桌面使用4GB图形卡,2017年笔记本电脑使用集成图形时每通过4分钟不到. 模型以根-正方形误差复制了广视全尺度约2.3-3.1%的渲染. 这种方法可以使复杂的CT数据更容易在没有CT数据或音量渲染器的情况下交互分享和查看,对通信和教学具有潜在价值。
